commit_note: Application source SHA built and published; delivery metadata commit reported separately to avoid self-reference.

findings.AUD-20: FIXED (MEDIUM: username enumeration via login timing)

findings.AUD-24: OPEN (MEDIUM, deployment: per-process counters; proxy IP shared partition; needs gateway/WAF limit)

technical_decisions: Custom in-memory fixed-window throttle on TimeProvider instead of System.Threading.RateLimiting (no TimeProvider support in .NET 8; account partition needs bound form data)
Two partitions: SHA-256 normalized account (5/5 min, IP independent) and socket IP (20/5 min); all attempts counted; no SQL, no permanent lockout
Throttle evaluated before validation, lookup and hashing; antiforgery still runs first
No forwarded-header processing; trusted proxies not configured without approval
Central no-store middleware after UseStaticFiles; Clear-Site-Data cache on logout
Customer Portal not republished: no source or dependency change

technical_decisions: Reuse Roles/UserRoles; no new tables, no role creation, no RolePermissions editing

Audit row in dbo.AuditLogs inside the same transaction when the table and columns exist; otherwise application log warning and UI notice
Granting SYS_ADMIN to another user remains allowed for SYS_ADMIN (unchanged from user creation)

technical_decisions: Login eligibility = IsDeleted=0 AND IsActive=1 AND Status='ACTIVE' everywhere (already true in SQL; now explicit in AccountStatusPolicy)
Status is never changed by the UI; unknown status values keep the account locked
Soft delete sets IsDeleted=1, IsActive=0 (DeletedAt/DeletedBy only if columns exist); no cascade to roles, memberships or history
Tax code: whitespace-only normalization, 10 or 10-3 digits for new/changed values, duplicates checked among all non-deleted customers
Durable audit mandatory only when Security:Audit:RequireDurableAudit=true, enabled by operator after scripts/007 PASS
Superseded unguarded PortalDb write methods removed
